name: plan-cmd-e2e-update-replacement-single-roster-agent
body: The task-update e2e (plan_update_task_at_preserves_status_reviews_and_revalidates) exercises the assigned-to Agent replacement re-validation only against the single roster Agent `agent.implementer` that `db_at` carries — the "replacement" re-supplies the same agent rather than swapping to a distinct valid one. A genuinely different assigned Agent (asserting a swap lands and is re-validated against the branch roster) is not covered because the shared fixture DB seeds exactly one Agent. Upgrade — add a second Agent to the `db_at` roster (or a task-local fixture) and assert a swap to it lands — only if distinct-agent replacement needs explicit coverage.
